text_blocks.snippet: A COVID-19 antigen test is a rapid diagnostic test used to detect the presence of SARS-CoV-2, the virus that causes COVID-19.
snippet_highlighted_words: a rapid diagnostic test used to detect the presence of SARS-CoV-2, the virus that causes COVID-19

list.snippet: The test collects a sample of nasal or throat mucus.
The sample is mixed with a solution containing antibodies that specifically recognize viral proteins (antigens).
If the sample contains viral antigens, the antibodies bind to them, producing a visible result, such as a colored line on a test strip.
